description: This file appears to be a shell script used in an OpenWRT platform upgrade process, defining functions for checking and performing firmware upgrades based on the board.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: A function that checks the integrity of the firmware image; currently always returns success (0).

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process based on the board name; defaults to calling default_do_upgrade for unknown board types.
